arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Pre-race test: CP shaft 201 W / 16.3 kJ, boat 131 W / 8.6 kJ (can be 10-25 pct off). Plan: let the hard start settle by min 2-3; hold shaft ~200-205 W (near CP) through legs 1-6, checking CP with heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP). Mid-race (around 4-5 km) consider a short piece to test CP / blade share if useful. Watch push_local for sudden drops not explained by turns (weed -> clear_rudder; or pod drift -> pod gain). Final ~1.2-1.5 km: spend remaining reserve, finish cue around 400-600 m. Listen to radio for course changes (set_race_distance).

So the pod reads LOW (gain ~0.79 and maybe falling), not paddler easing, not weed. Pod reserve and push_local now unreliable (pod reserve falsely refilling). Ratio shaft/boat power was ~1.48 before; defined pod_ratio to track. Plan: once ratio stabilises, set pod_gain = ratio/1.48 since_race_s ~775.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m (out legs face push ~-0.15..-0.19 m/s, back legs helped). Facts so far: CP pod ~201 (HR rose 0.7 bpm/min at 213 W, ~0.3/min at 205-209 W, so CP maybe 201-207). Boat CP set 142. POD DRIFT at 775-880 s: pod now reads ~0.75 of true; pod_gain 0.75 set since 830 s (pod_reading_raw ~157 = true ~209). Weed on rudder ~830-958 s, cleared by back-stroke (speed recovered). Plan: hold true ~203-206 W through 8.5 km; watch HR (if it climbs >0.7/min, ease); recheck pod gain vs boat power each leg (pod_ratio stream: corrected pod / boat power ~1.44 when right). Finish: from ~1.2 km out spend reserve (check w_bal_pod_frac and CP range), finish cue ~400-500 m. Watch sudden_slow alerts for more weed; radio may change the course (set_race_distance).
